To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
citizens’ trust towards e-government in Saudi Arabia is influenced by technology, government agencies and citizens’ characteristic.
citizens’ trust towards e-government is influenced by technology, government agencies and citizens characteristic, but risk has a negative effect on trust in e-government.
the trust of citizens towards government agencies has a significant impact on their trust in e-government.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of citizens’ trust on e-government.
the development of trust in the context of e-government in developing countries.
the development of citizens ’ trust towards successful adoption and implementation of e-government.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this research is the first attempt to investigate trust in e-government in Saudi Arabia.
trust is a key factor in e-government adoption and it is a complex construct which needs to be investigated in more detail.
the trust is a multidimensional concept and the trust in e-government is a complex issue and needs to be addressed from different aspects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this research provides a better understanding of the concept and the antecedents of trust in e-govt.
the findings of this study provide a deep understanding on the influence of different factors on citizens’ trust towards e-government.
this paper is one of the few studies in Saudi Arabia that investigated trust in e-Government and its determinants from the citizen perspective.
The main takeaway from our work is that
citizens’ trust towards e-government is influenced by both technical factors and government agencies factors.
the trust in e-government can be improved by enhancing the quality of the e-government services and the citizens’ characteristic.
citizens’ characteristics, such as gender, education and age are important factors to be considered when developing e-government services in Saudi Arabia.
